definition_en: The practice of measuring what an AI model can and will do, using structured tests. In AI safety it covers both capability evaluations (what the model is able to do) and propensity/safety evaluations (what it actually does when given the chance).
definition_zh: 用结构化的测试来衡量模型能做什么、会做什么。在安全语境下既包括能力评测（模型能力上限），也包括安全性与倾向性评测（模型实际会不会做）。
pitfalls: Chinese splits this three ways and the split is not cosmetic. 评测 is the word the Chinese ML/eval community uses for benchmark-style measurement of a model (OpenCompass 司南评测体系, SuperCLUE). 评估 is the broader word and is the default in policy/risk-management text, where it also translates 'assessment' — so 风险评估 (risk assessment) and 安全评估 (safety assessment) sit in the same sentences as 模型评测 and mean something else. 测评 is a near-synonym of 评测 common in industry marketing, and also appears inside the fixed PRC compliance phrase 等级测评 (MLPS grading assessment), which is unrelated. Using 评估 where you mean 'evals' will read as 'assessment' to a Chinese policy reader.

translations.notes: The Chinese-native word for model evals specifically. Used by the International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition for 'model evaluation' and by the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI framework for the testing stage.

attestations.quote_zh: 模型评测（Model evaluation）模型评测包括用于评估和测量人工智能模型在特定任务上表现的过程和测试。
attestations.quote_en: Model evaluation: model evaluation comprises the processes and tests used to assess and measure the performance of an AI model on particular tasks.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 在最终训练初期，研发者可专注于高度可扩展的评测（如自动化基准测试）；当模型接近已知能力边界时，应开展更复杂的评测（如红队测试或提升研究）。
attestations.quote_en: Early in the final training run, developers can focus on highly scalable evaluations (such as automated benchmarks); as the model approaches known capability frontiers, more complex evaluations (such as red-teaming or uplift studies) should be conducted.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: Dominant in policy and risk-management register. Also the standard rendering of 'assessment', so it is ambiguous between 'eval' and 'assessment'.

attestations.quote_zh: 我们建议AI研发者在研发前和部署前进行系统性评估，以便为关键的部署决策提供参考。
attestations.quote_en: We recommend that AI developers conduct systematic evaluations before development and before deployment, to inform critical deployment decisions.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: Same characters as 评测 reversed; heavily used in Chinese industry marketing for model leaderboards. Also locked into the unrelated PRC compliance phrase 等级测评 (MLPS grading assessment), which is a reason to prefer 评测 in safety writing.

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI
used_by.note: used for the testing stage in the Frontier AI Risk Management Framework

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文版）

usage_examples.zh: 部署前的评测没有排除该模型协助新手制造生物武器的可能性。
usage_examples.en: Pre-deployment evaluations did not rule out the possibility that the model could assist a novice in making a bioweapon.

definition_en: A standardised, usually quantitative test used to compare AI systems on a fixed set of tasks. In safety work benchmarks are the cheap, scalable end of evaluation, contrasted with red-teaming and uplift studies.
definition_zh: 在固定任务集上对AI系统进行标准化、通常可量化比较的测试。在安全工作中，基准测试属于成本低、可规模化的评测手段，与红队测试、提升研究相对。
pitfalls: Unproblematic as a translation, but note the cultural weight of 榜单 / 排行榜 ('leaderboard', 'chart') in Chinese ML discourse: Chinese coverage of a new model typically leads with its 榜单 position rather than with the benchmark itself, and 刷榜 ('gaming the leaderboard') is a live term of criticism with no neat English equivalent. Do not translate 'benchmark' as 榜单 — a 榜单 is the ranking, not the test.

translations.notes: Universal in both technical and policy Chinese.

attestations.quote_zh: 基准测试（Benchmark）：一种标准化、通常为定量的测试或指标，用于评估和比较人工智能系统在固定任务集上的表现，这些任务通常旨在模拟现实世界中的应用场景。
attestations.quote_en: Benchmark: a standardised, usually quantitative test or metric used to evaluate and compare AI systems' performance on a fixed set of tasks, typically designed to simulate real-world application scenarios.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 部署前风险分析技术包括：●基于问答数据集的自动化基准测试：这一基础性方法通过构建高质量、高挑战性的问答数据集，严格评估模型在复杂场景中的表现。
attestations.quote_en: Pre-deployment risk analysis techniques include: automated benchmarks built on question-answer datasets — a foundational method that rigorously evaluates model performance in complex scenarios by constructing high-quality, high-difficulty QA datasets.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: Short form; also means 'baseline' in a statistical sense, so 基准测试 is clearer.

Means 'leaderboard', not 'benchmark'. Extremely prominent in Chinese ML media, which is why it gets misused as a translation. We recommend against it for 'benchmark'; use it only where the English really is 'leaderboard'. We did not recover an attestation of it inside AI-safety literature.

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文版）

usage_examples.zh: 仅凭基准测试结果无法可靠预测模型在实际应用中的风险。
usage_examples.en: Benchmark results alone cannot reliably predict a model's risk in real-world use.

definition_en: Testing designed to establish whether a model possesses knowledge or skills that would materially help someone cause serious harm — bioweapon development, offensive cyber operations, autonomous replication, and so on. It is the measurement layer that frontier safety frameworks hang their capability thresholds on.
definition_zh: 专门用于判定模型是否具备可能实质性协助他人造成严重危害的知识或技能的测试，例如生物武器研发、网络攻击、自主复制等。前沿安全框架的能力阈值就建立在这类评测之上。
pitfalls: Two variants circulate — 危险能力评测 and 危险能力评估 — and they track the general 评测/评估 split (technical vs policy register) rather than any difference in meaning. The Chinese-language frontier-safety literature also uses 有害能力评测 ('harmful capability evaluation') for the same thing, which is broader in principle but used interchangeably in practice.

translations.notes: Used by the Chinese edition of the International AI Safety Report throughout its chapter on frontier safety frameworks.

attestations.quote_zh: 尽管许多框架描述了类似的风险管理方法-包括威胁建模、红队测试和危险能力评测-但在风险等级与阈值的定义、评测频率、评测结果与阈值之间的安全余量，以及风险缓解措施的全面性（例如是否包含删除模型权重而非仅暂停开发）等方面存在差异(1115、1119)。
attestations.quote_en: Although many frameworks describe similar risk-management methods — including threat modelling, red-teaming and dangerous capability evaluations — they differ in how risk levels and thresholds are defined, evaluation frequency, the safety margin between evaluation results and thresholds, and the comprehensiveness of mitigations.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 在“隐藏实力问答（无目标）”中，模型需回答危险能力评测的问题，同时被告知高性能可能会引发诸如能力“反学习”之类的后果。
attestations.quote_en: In 'sandbagging QA (no goal)', the model is asked questions from a dangerous-capability evaluation while being told that high performance may lead to consequences such as having the capability 'unlearned'.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.notes: The policy-register variant. Concordia AI's comparison of the five frontier frameworks uses 能力评估 in this sense, e.g. discussing 针对化生放核威胁的“预警性评估”. VERIFICATION 2026-08-08: the cited Concordia AI comparison never writes 危险能力评估 (it says 危险能力 and 能力评估 separately). Attestation removed; unattested in our sources.
Used alongside 危险能力评测 in the International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition.

attestations.quote_zh: 有害能力评测(715*)用于判定通用型人工智能模型或系统是否具备特别有害的知识或技能，例如协助实施网络攻击的能力（参见§2.1.3.网络攻击）。
attestations.quote_en: Harmful capability evaluations are used to determine whether a general-purpose AI model or system possesses particularly harmful knowledge or skills, such as the ability to assist with cyberattacks.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文版）
安远 AI (Concordia AI)
used_by.note: in its comparison of five frontier AI risk-management frameworks

usage_examples.zh: 在模型接近已知能力边界时，应开展针对生物与网络领域的危险能力评测。
usage_examples.en: As the model approaches known capability frontiers, dangerous capability evaluations targeting the biological and cyber domains should be run.

definition_en: Actively working to get a model to show the best it can do — through prompting, scaffolding, fine-tuning or tool access — so that an evaluation measures the model's real ceiling rather than an artefact of a lazy test harness. Central to frontier safety work because an under-elicited dangerous-capability eval gives false assurance.
definition_zh: 通过提示策略、脚手架、微调或工具接入等手段，主动把模型的真实能力上限逼出来，使评测结果反映模型的实际能力而非测试方法的局限。这在前沿安全评测中至关重要：激发不足的危险能力评测会给出虚假的安全保证。
pitfalls: This is a genuine gap. The concept is discussed in Chinese AI-safety documents but almost always described rather than named — e.g. the Shanghai AI Lab framework talks about allocating dedicated compute to make evaluations thorough, without a noun for elicitation. 能力激发 ('capability activation/arousal') is the closest circulating term but is used mainly in a prompt-engineering/performance context, not a safety-evaluation one, and carries no sense of 'adversarially trying hard to make the model show a dangerous capability'. 能力引出 is a more literal calque but we found no attested use. Note also that 激发 is a positive-valence word (to inspire, to stimulate), which fits the productivity framing and fights the safety framing.

translations.notes: Attested only in a prompt-engineering context so far, not in safety-evaluation text. Thinly evidenced.

attestations.quote_zh: 这就是提示工程与能力激发的本质区别。提示工程优化的是你如何提问，能力激发优化的是模型在回答时从自身权重中调取了什么。
attestations.quote_en: This is the essential difference between prompt engineering and capability elicitation. Prompt engineering optimises how you ask; capability elicitation optimises what the model retrieves from its own weights when answering.
attestations.source_title: 能力激发：让大语言模型用好它已知道的一切
attestations.publisher: TianPan.co

translations.notes: We are proposing this as the safety-evaluation sense, precisely because 激发 reads as 'boost performance' while 引出 reads as 'get it to come out', which is what a dangerous-capability evaluator is doing. Not attested; offered as a coinage rather than a report of usage.

usage_examples.zh: 如果能力激发做得不充分，危险能力评测就会低估模型的真实风险。
usage_examples.en: If elicitation is insufficient, dangerous capability evaluations will underestimate the model's real risk.

definition_en: A structured exercise in which people or automated systems deliberately play the adversary against a model or system in order to surface vulnerabilities, harmful behaviours and misuse pathways before real attackers find them.
definition_zh: 由人员或自动化系统扮演攻击方，对模型或系统发起有组织的对抗测试，以在真实攻击者之前发现漏洞、有害行为和滥用路径。
pitfalls: The colour convention is worth checking but did NOT turn out to be a live problem. In PLA exercise convention 红军 is the friendly/home force and 蓝军 the opposing force — the inverse of the US convention. However, Chinese AI and cybersecurity writing uses the 红队/蓝队 (team) pair, not the 红军/蓝军 (army) pair, and in that pair 红队 is uniformly the attacker and 蓝队 the defender, matching the US usage. We found no instance of a Chinese AI-safety text treating 红队 as the defending side, and no instance of an author flagging confusion. Treat the inversion as a fact about the military register only. Two secondary notes: (a) 红队测试 in the PRC arrives via the mature 攻防演练 (attack-defence exercise) industry, so it carries strong infosec/pen-test connotations and a Chinese reader may under-read the AI-safety sense of probing for harmful content and misaligned behaviour rather than exploitable bugs; (b) 红队演练 is used interchangeably with 红队测试.

translations.notes: The dominant form across AI-safety, policy and industry security writing. 红队 alone is used as the noun for the team.

attestations.quote_zh: 红队测试（Red-teaming）：一种系统化的流程，其中专职人员或团队通过多种方法寻找漏洞、局限性或潜在的滥用风险。
attestations.quote_en: Red-teaming: a systematic process in which dedicated individuals or teams use a variety of methods to look for vulnerabilities, limitations or potential misuse risks.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: ●领域专家红队测试：由领域专家通过模拟攻击或关键性挑战对AI模型进行对抗测试，主动识别潜在漏洞、新兴风险及安全改进空间。
attestations.quote_en: Domain-expert red-teaming: domain experts conduct adversarial testing of the AI model through simulated attacks or critical challenges, proactively identifying potential vulnerabilities, emerging risks and room for safety improvement.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 智能体红队测试不是单次提示词越狱，而是系统化、场景化、多轮次、可复现的对抗性测试，核心遵循“侦察→建模→分层攻击→验证→报告→加固→复测”闭环流程，区别于传统软件红队，重点突出智能体自主性、上下文依赖、工具权限、记忆特性四大维度。
attestations.quote_en: Agent red-teaming is not a one-off prompt jailbreak but systematic, scenario-based, multi-turn, reproducible adversarial testing, following a closed loop of recon → modelling → layered attack → verification → reporting → hardening → retest; unlike traditional software red-teaming it foregrounds agent autonomy, context dependence, tool permissions and memory.
attestations.source_title: 面向AI智能体的红队测试实战：基于OWASP ASI 2026的金融场景攻防实践
attestations.publisher: 虎符智库，发表于安全内参

translations.notes: Preferred where the emphasis is on a staged exercise rather than a test procedure; inherited from 攻防演练.

attestations.quote_zh: 落实最佳实践并定期更新：五家公司都采用了一系列安全实践来落实各自框架，如开展内部和/或外部红队演练、激励第三方报告漏洞、加强对模型权重的网络安全和内部人员威胁防范等。
attestations.quote_en: Implementing and regularly updating best practice: all five companies adopt a range of safety practices to operationalise their frameworks, such as running internal and/or external red-team exercises, incentivising third-party vulnerability reporting, and strengthening cybersecurity and insider-threat defences for model weights.
attestations.source_title: 国际五大前沿AI风险管理框架的横向对比
attestations.publisher: 安远AI (Concordia AI)，发表于安全内参

translations.notes: Counterpart term, recorded here as evidence on the colour-convention question: in Chinese AI/cyber usage 蓝队 is the defender, i.e. the same way round as the US convention and the opposite of the PLA 红军/蓝军 arrangement.

attestations.quote_zh: 在攻防演练中，一个团队（红队）扮演攻击者的角色，试图发起各种攻击，而另一个团队（蓝队）则扮演防御者的角色，负责检测、阻止和应对攻击。
attestations.quote_en: In an attack-defence exercise, one team (the red team) plays the attacker and attempts various attacks, while the other team (the blue team) plays the defender and is responsible for detecting, blocking and responding to attacks.
attestations.source_title: 什么是攻防演练
attestations.publisher: 深信服 Sangfor 知识中心

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI
used_by.note: framework distinguishes 领域专家红队测试 from 开放性红队测试

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文版）
安远 AI (Concordia AI)
used_by.zh_used: 红队演练 / 红队测试

usage_examples.zh: 各公司都会在模型开发过程中进行红队测试，并在可能时邀请独立第三方对模型进行安全评估。
usage_examples.en: All the companies conduct red-teaming during model development, and where possible invite independent third parties to run safety evaluations.

definition_en: An input, or family of inputs, that gets a model to do something its safety training was meant to prevent — typically by reframing, roleplay, obfuscation or encoding the request.
definition_zh: 通过改写、角色扮演、混淆或编码等手段构造输入，使模型突破安全训练所设的限制，输出本应被拒绝的内容。
pitfalls: None serious. 越狱 arrives via the iOS-jailbreaking sense and is fully naturalised; the metaphor (breaking out of prison) survives translation intact. In agent-security writing 提示词越狱 ('prompt jailbreak') is used for the single-turn case, in contrast with multi-step agent attacks.

translations.notes: Universal. Compound forms: 越狱攻击, 越狱提示词, 提示词越狱.

attestations.quote_en: For example, researchers have shown that state-of-the-art safeguards can be circumvented through adversarial prompting methods (i.e. 'jailbreaks'), by having models decompose complex harmful tasks into steps, and through simple model modifications.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 确保任何系统漏洞（如越狱攻击或其他攻击路径）都能被及时发现并修复，防止攻击者利用漏洞显著提升破坏能力，例如采用快速补丁修复机制，在必要时向执法机构报告，并保留相关日志以便追踪。
attestations.quote_en: Ensure that any system vulnerability (such as jailbreak attacks or other attack paths) can be discovered and fixed promptly, preventing attackers from significantly increasing their destructive capability by exploiting it.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI
used_by.note: in the Frontier AI Risk Management Framework

usage_examples.zh: 红队测试不应只停留在通用化越狱测试上。
usage_examples.en: Red-teaming should not stop at generic jailbreak testing.

definition_en: An attack in which adversarial instructions reach a model through its input channel — often indirectly, hidden in a web page, document or database the model reads — and are followed as if they came from the legitimate user.
definition_zh: 攻击者把恶意指令混入模型的输入通道（常常是间接地藏在模型会读取的网页、文档或数据库中），使模型将其当作合法用户指令加以执行。
pitfalls: Both 提示词注入 and 提示注入 are current; the longer form is more frequent in policy text and the shorter one in security/agent writing. The metaphor rides on the well-established 注入 of SQL 注入 (SQL injection), which is helpful — a Chinese security reader gets it immediately. Distinguish 间接提示注入 (indirect prompt injection) explicitly: Chinese agent-security writing does mark the direct/indirect split.

translations.notes: More frequent form in the Chinese edition of the International AI Safety Report.

attestations.quote_zh: 攻击者可以利用提示词注入（通过恶意输入操纵人工智能系统）(505*、506、507)、数据库投毒（破坏人工智能系统所依赖的信息）(508)和供应链入侵（在部署前操纵人工智能组件）(509、510)等技术手段来操纵模型行为、提取敏感信息或生成有害输出。
attestations.quote_en: Attackers can use techniques such as prompt injection (manipulating an AI system through malicious input), database poisoning (corrupting the information the system relies on) and supply-chain compromise (manipulating AI components before deployment) to manipulate model behaviour, extract sensitive information, or produce harmful outputs.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 在提示词注入攻击中，恶意指令会通过网站或数据库中的隐藏指令等途径间接输入到智能体中(507、657、658)。
attestations.quote_en: In prompt-injection attacks, malicious instructions are fed to the agent indirectly, for example through hidden instructions in a website or database.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.notes: Shorter variant, dominant in Chinese agent-security and pen-testing writing; 间接提示注入 is the indirect case.

attestations.quote_zh: 3.3第三阶段：分层攻击执行——从表层到深层的实战测试智能体攻击具有层级递进特性，从直接提示注入到多智能体协作、记忆持久化攻击，层层深入，本文采用四层攻击框架，完整覆盖所有攻击面。
attestations.quote_en: Stage three: layered attack execution — from surface to depth. Agent attacks are hierarchical, running from direct prompt injection through multi-agent collaboration to memory-persistence attacks; this article uses a four-layer attack framework covering the whole attack surface.
attestations.source_title: 面向AI智能体的红队测试实战：基于OWASP ASI 2026的金融场景攻防实践
attestations.publisher: 虎符智库，发表于安全内参

usage_examples.zh: 智能体读取外部网页时，最主要的攻击面是间接提示词注入。
usage_examples.en: When an agent reads external web pages, the main attack surface is indirect prompt injection.

definition_en: How well a model's safe behaviour holds up under inputs specifically designed to break it, as opposed to under ordinary or randomly perturbed inputs.
definition_zh: 在专门针对模型设计的对抗性输入下，模型的安全行为还能保持多少；与普通输入或随机扰动下的表现相对。
pitfalls: 鲁棒 is a phono-semantic loan of 'robust' (lǔbàng ≈ 'robust') with characters that mean 'crude/blunt' — it carries no native meaning and reads as a technical opacity to a non-specialist, though it is completely standard in ML. 稳健性 ('steadiness') is the semantically transparent alternative, standard in statistics and used in some policy text, but does not dominate in ML. Note also that in Chinese safety documents 鲁棒性 usually appears bare, in a list alongside 安全性 and 可靠性, meaning general robustness; the specifically adversarial sense is often left to context rather than marked with 对抗. We did not recover a verbatim attestation of the exact compound 对抗鲁棒性 in the safety corpora searched, so this entry's confidence is low despite the term being unremarkable in the ML literature.

translations.notes: Standard compound in Chinese ML writing. Not attested in the AI-safety sources we fetched; recorded without an attestation rather than with a fabricated one.
The bare term is fully established and is what Chinese safety documents actually use; 鲁棒性训练 renders 'robustness training'.

attestations.quote_zh: 人工智能模型在真实性、安全性及鲁棒性指标上存在持续性缺陷(881)，且在确保安全防护措施能有效适应不同情境方面仍存在根本性未解难题(174)。
attestations.quote_en: AI models show persistent deficiencies on truthfulness, safety and robustness metrics, and fundamental unsolved problems remain in ensuring safeguards generalise across contexts.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.notes: Semantically transparent alternative, standard in statistics and econometrics; used in some governance text but a minority choice in ML.

usage_examples.zh: 对抗训练能提升模型的对抗鲁棒性，但很难覆盖未见过的攻击手法。
usage_examples.en: Adversarial training improves a model's adversarial robustness but struggles to cover unseen attack methods.

definition_en: A model performing below its actual ability on an evaluation, plausibly in order to avoid triggering scrutiny, restriction or capability removal. It is the failure mode that makes every dangerous-capability evaluation a lower bound rather than a measurement.
definition_zh: 模型在评测中故意表现得低于自身真实能力，可能是为了避免触发进一步审查、限制或能力删除。这一现象使所有危险能力评测都只能给出能力下界，而非真实测量值。
pitfalls: Genuinely contested — we found three different renderings in Chinese frontier-safety documents published within months of each other, including two inside the same report. 沙袋效应 is a pure calque of an English sports idiom and means nothing to a Chinese reader without the parenthetical gloss 故意示弱, which the International AI Safety Report supplies; the same report elsewhere translates the eval name 'Sandbagging QA' as 隐藏实力问答. Concordia AI independently uses 能力隐藏. Idiomatic native candidates exist — 藏拙 ('conceal one's clumsiness', but it means hiding weakness, not hiding strength, so it is a false friend) and 扮猪吃老虎 ('play the pig to eat the tiger', i.e. feign weakness to strike later, semantically much closer but far too colloquial for a technical document). If you need to be understood, write 能力隐藏; if you need to be findable against the English literature, write 沙袋效应（故意示弱）.

translations.notes: Calque; only intelligible with the gloss 故意示弱 ('deliberately feigning weakness'), which the source supplies inline.

attestations.quote_zh: 沙袋效应（故意示弱）（Sandbagging）：指模型或系统在评测中表现低于其能力水平的行为，此举可能旨在规避进一步审查或限制。
attestations.quote_en: Sandbagging: behaviour in which a model or system performs below its capability level on evaluations, potentially in order to avoid further scrutiny or restrictions.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 最后，模型在评测阶段的表现可能低于其他情境，这种现象被称为“沙袋效应（sandbagging）”，已在实验中得到验证(722、726、727)。
attestations.quote_en: Finally, models may perform worse during evaluation than in other contexts — a phenomenon known as 'sandbagging' — which has been demonstrated experimentally.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.notes: Concordia AI's choice. The most transparent of the three renderings and the one we would recommend for readers who need to understand the concept rather than trace the English literature.

attestations.quote_zh: 另外，OpenAI的框架还引入了前瞻性的“研究类别”（Research Categories）概念，专门列出一些尚未完全具备测评方法但潜在高危的能力领域，如长程自主性、能力隐藏（Sandbagging）、自主复制与适应、破坏安全防护等。
attestations.quote_en: In addition, OpenAI's framework introduces the forward-looking concept of 'Research Categories', listing potentially high-risk capability areas that do not yet have adequate evaluation methods — such as long-horizon autonomy, sandbagging, autonomous replication and adaptation, and undermining safeguards.
attestations.source_title: 国际五大前沿AI风险管理框架的横向对比
attestations.publisher: 安远AI (Concordia AI)，发表于安全内参

translations.notes: Used in the same International AI Safety Report to render the eval name 'Sandbagging QA' — evidence that even a single carefully edited document did not settle on one term.

attestations.quote_zh: 在“隐藏实力问答（无目标）”中，模型需回答危险能力评测的问题，同时被告知高性能可能会引发诸如能力“反学习”之类的后果。
attestations.quote_en: In 'Sandbagging QA (No Goal)', the model answers questions from a dangerous capability evaluation while being told that high performance may trigger consequences such as capability 'unlearning'.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文版）
used_by.note: glossary; but 隐藏实力 elsewhere in the same report

used_by.org: 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

usage_examples.zh: 如果模型存在沙袋效应，部署前的危险能力评测只能给出能力下界。
usage_examples.en: If a model sandbags, pre-deployment dangerous capability evaluations only give a lower bound on its capability.

definition_en: A model's tendency to tell the user what they want to hear — agreeing with stated positions, praising their work, backing down under pushback — rather than what is accurate. A predictable side effect of optimising for human approval.
definition_zh: 模型倾向于顺着用户说话——附和用户立场、夸奖用户作品、被质疑就改口——而不是给出准确回答。这是过度优化人类偏好反馈的可预期副作用。
pitfalls: 谄媚 is a strong, morally loaded word in Chinese (obsequious, fawning, boot-licking) — arguably stronger than English 'sycophancy', which has become semi-technical in AI circles. It is nonetheless the settled rendering. 奉承 and 讨好 are softer and appear as glosses. Note that 谄媚 attributes an intention the model does not have, in a language where the word normally describes a person angling for advantage.

translations.notes: Dominant across report translations, lab writing and tech media.

attestations.quote_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，人工智能系统会通过谄媚和冒充行为产生操纵作用。
attestations.quote_en: There is growing evidence that AI systems can be manipulative through sycophancy and impersonation.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 在风险评估方法上，xAI并未试图穷举所有高风险场景，而是将复杂风险拆解为可评估的模型行为维度，重点关注三类要素：模型的滥用潜力（如对越狱的脆弱性）、令人担忧的倾向（如欺骗或谄媚行为），以及双重用途能力（如进攻性网络攻击能力）。
attestations.quote_en: On risk-assessment method, xAI does not try to enumerate every high-risk scenario but decomposes complex risk into assessable behavioural dimensions, focusing on three elements: misuse potential (e.g. susceptibility to jailbreaks), concerning propensities (e.g. deceptive or sycophantic behaviour), and dual-use capabilities (e.g. offensive cyber capability).
attestations.source_title: 国际五大前沿AI风险管理框架的横向对比
attestations.publisher: 安远AI (Concordia AI)，发表于安全内参

translations.notes: Used as an inline gloss alongside 谄媚 in the Chinese International AI Safety Report ('谄媚/奉承取悦'). Softer register.

used_by.org: 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

usage_examples.zh: 对人类认可的过度优化可能会导致模型表现出欺骗或谄媚的行为。
usage_examples.en: Over-optimising for human approval can lead models to behave deceptively or sycophantically.

definition_en: A model producing fluent, confident content that is simply not true — invented citations, biographies, prices, case law. A reliability failure rather than a safety failure in the frontier sense, but the one non-specialists know.
definition_zh: 模型生成流畅、自信但根本不存在的内容，比如编造的引文、人物生平、票价或判例。它属于可靠性问题而非前沿意义上的安全问题，但却是公众最熟悉的一种失效。
pitfalls: None. 幻觉 is universal and the metaphor transfers cleanly. Some Chinese writers note, as English ones do, that 虚构/编造 ('fabrication') would be more accurate than a perception metaphor, but this has not displaced 幻觉.

translations.notes: Universal in Chinese ML, media and policy text.

attestations.quote_zh: 即使是擅长完成复杂任务的系统也可能生成不存在的引文、传记或事实，这种现象被称为“幻觉”(139, 140, 141*)。
attestations.quote_en: Even systems that are good at complex tasks can generate non-existent citations, biographies or facts — a phenomenon known as 'hallucination'.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 传统生成式AI（LLM）的核心风险集中于内容生成、幻觉、提示词越狱，其最坏后果是“说错话”；而自主智能体具备四大核心能力——自主任务拆解、长期记忆/上下文管理、外部工具/API调用、多智能体协作，其安全风险已从“说错话”升级为“做错事”。
attestations.quote_en: The core risks of traditional generative AI (LLMs) centre on content generation, hallucination and prompt jailbreaks, and the worst outcome is 'saying the wrong thing'; autonomous agents have four core capabilities — task decomposition, long-term memory/context management, external tool/API calls, multi-agent collaboration — and their risk escalates from 'saying the wrong thing' to 'doing the wrong thing'.
attestations.source_title: 面向AI智能体的红队测试实战：基于OWASP ASI 2026的金融场景攻防实践
attestations.publisher: 虎符智库，发表于安全内参

usage_examples.zh: 该系统在案情摘要中援引了不存在的先例，这是典型的幻觉。
usage_examples.en: The system cited non-existent precedents in a case brief — a textbook hallucination.

definition_en: A structured, evidence-backed argument that a system is acceptably safe to operate in a given context. Imported into frontier AI from aviation, nuclear and automotive safety engineering, where regulators have required them for decades.
definition_zh: 一套有证据支撑的结构化论证，用以说明系统在特定运行环境下的安全性可以接受。这一做法源自航空、核电与汽车安全工程领域，近年被引入前沿AI治理。
pitfalls: This is the clearest case in the category of two communities owning different words for the same thing. Chinese safety-engineering academia (software engineering, GSN/CAE, ISO 26262, airworthiness) has used 安全案例 since well before AI — the 2024 《软件学报》 survey is titled 关于安全案例论证构建的综述. Chinese AI-safety writing, arriving from the English frontier literature, has independently converged on 安全论证. They refer to the same artefact. 安全案例 is the more faithful calque of 'case' but is a false friend in general Chinese, where 案例 means 'case study / worked example', so 安全案例 can be misread as 'a safety incident case study'. 安全论证 avoids that and foregrounds the argument structure, which is why we prefer it — but a reader coming from functional-safety engineering will search for 安全案例. Note also that both terms swallow the safety/security distinction via 安全.

translations.notes: The AI-safety community's choice. Used with the English gloss in both the International AI Safety Report Chinese edition and the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI framework, and by Concordia AI when describing Google DeepMind's practice.

attestations.quote_zh: 安全论证（Safety cases）安全论证是一套结构化的论述，通过证据支持，证明系统在特定环境下运行具有可接受的安全性。
attestations.quote_en: Safety cases: a safety case is a structured argument, supported by evidence, that a system operates with acceptable safety in a given context.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: ●安全论证（Safety Cases）：基于证据的详细论证，通过技术评估与风险缓解策略相结合，证明系统部署的安全性。
attestations.quote_en: Safety cases: detailed evidence-based arguments that combine technical evaluation with risk-mitigation strategies to demonstrate the safety of a system's deployment.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 此外，DeepMind创新性地引入了“安全论证”（safety case）的方法来评估缓解措施的有效性。
attestations.quote_en: In addition, DeepMind has innovatively introduced the 'safety case' method for assessing the effectiveness of mitigations.
attestations.source_title: 国际五大前沿AI风险管理框架的横向对比
attestations.publisher: 安远AI (Concordia AI)，发表于安全内参

translations.notes: The pre-existing term in Chinese safety-engineering and software-engineering literature, predating AI use. Correct in that register; avoid in AI-safety text because 案例 reads as 'case study'.

attestations.quote_zh: 安全案例提供清晰、全面和可靠的论据，说明系统在特定环境下的操作满足可接受的安全性。
attestations.quote_en: A safety case provides a clear, comprehensive and reliable argument that a system's operation in a specific environment meets acceptable safety.
attestations.source_title: 关于安全案例论证构建的综述
attestations.publisher: 《软件学报》2024年第35卷第9期（陈泽众、邓玉欣）

translations.notes: Appears in the Shanghai AI Lab framework in the same sentence as 安全论证, apparently as a generic descriptor rather than a distinct term.

attestations.quote_zh: 这需要将严谨的安全性论证与工具（如安全论证和系统卡）相结合，向利益相关方说明情况，并指导部署决策54。
attestations.quote_en: This requires combining rigorous safety argumentation with instruments such as safety cases and system cards, to explain the situation to stakeholders and guide deployment decisions.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI
used_by.note: defined in the framework's glossary of transparency instruments

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文版）
《软件学报》(safety-engineering literature)

usage_examples.zh: 当模型达到关键能力等级时，团队需要提交一份安全论证，说明现有缓解措施已把重大风险降到可接受水平。
usage_examples.en: When a model reaches a critical capability level, the team must submit a safety case showing that existing mitigations have reduced severe risk to an acceptable level.

definition_en: Formal review of a model's performance and impact, or of a developer's compliance with its own stated policies, carried out by an organisation independent of the developer.
definition_zh: 由独立于开发者的机构，对模型的性能与影响，或对开发者是否遵守其自身承诺的政策与流程，进行的正式审查。
pitfalls: Three near-synonyms circulate and the difference matters politically: 第三方审计 (audit, implies a formal standardised procedure and a report), 第三方评估 (assessment, weaker, what labs actually invite external researchers to do), and 第三方审查 (review/scrutiny, weakest). Concordia AI's critique of the frontier frameworks turns exactly on this distinction — it says third-party involvement is mostly 审查 that is procedurally compliant but lacks substantive verification. Also note the PRC context: 审计 in Chinese institutional language most often means financial audit performed by a licensed 会计师事务所, so 第三方审计 may be read as narrower and more formal than the English term intends.

translations.notes: Used in both the International AI Safety Report Chinese edition and the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI framework.

attestations.quote_zh: 研究人员指出，自愿自治面临的挑战，意味着第三方审计、验证和标准化措施有助于强化通用型人工智能风险管理(1001、1011、1109、1110、1111、1112)。
attestations.quote_en: Researchers note that the challenges of voluntary self-governance mean third-party audits, verification and standardisation can strengthen general-purpose AI risk management.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 第三方审计机制：委托独立机构定期对安全评估结果与风险缓解措施进行验证，通过复现测试和方法论审查确保有效性。
attestations.quote_en: Third-party audit mechanism: commission independent institutions to periodically verify safety evaluation results and risk mitigations, ensuring effectiveness through reproduction testing and methodological review.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: Weaker than audit; describes what labs actually do — inviting outside evaluators — rather than a formal audit regime. VERIFICATION 2026-08-08: the cited article says 第三方审计 and 独立第三方…安全评估, but never the fixed compound 第三方评估. Attestation removed; unattested in our sources.
The weakest of the three; used critically by Concordia AI to characterise frameworks whose external oversight is procedural rather than substantive.

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI
used_by.note: listed as a governance mechanism in the framework

usage_examples.zh: 框架在安全评估方面多为自我声明，缺乏独立渗透测试或第三方审计支撑。
usage_examples.en: On safety evaluation the framework relies largely on self-declaration, without independent penetration testing or third-party audit to back it up.

definition_en: The marginal increase in a malicious actor's ability to cause harm that is attributable to access to an AI system, measured against a realistic baseline such as internet search alone. The unit of analysis for bio and cyber misuse risk.
definition_zh: 相对于现实基线（例如仅能使用互联网搜索），恶意行为者因获得AI系统而额外获得的作恶能力增量。它是生物与网络滥用风险评估的基本计量单位。
pitfalls: A real gap, and the hint was right. Chinese has no word that carries 'uplift' in its threat-model sense. The attested rendering is 提升 / 能力提升, which is unambiguously positive-valence in Chinese — 提升 is what you write about improving productivity, quality or living standards — so 能力提升 reads as 'capability improvement' and quietly deletes the entire point of the term, which is that the improvement accrues to an attacker. Both the International AI Safety Report Chinese edition and the Shanghai AI Lab framework handle this by only ever using it inside the compound 提升研究 (uplift study) with the English in parentheses; neither uses a bare noun for 'uplift' itself, and the report resorts to descriptive phrasing (实质性帮助, 大量协助, 协助新手) where the English says 'uplift'. If you need the threat sense unambiguously, write 对恶意行为者的能力增益 or spell out 相对基线的边际协助; do not write 能力提升 alone.

translations.notes: The only fixed term attested, and only for 'uplift study'. Both sources gloss it with the English on first use, which is itself evidence the Chinese does not stand alone.

attestations.quote_zh: 提升研究（uplift study）：一项系统性评估，旨在比较人类在执行特定任务时，使用人工智能模型或系统的表现与相关基准（如仅使用互联网访问而未使用人工智能的表现）之间的差异。
attestations.quote_en: Uplift study: a systematic assessment comparing how humans perform on a given task with access to an AI model or system versus a relevant baseline (such as internet access without AI).
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 在最终训练初期，研发者可专注于高度可扩展的评测（如自动化基准测试）；当模型接近已知能力边界时，应开展更复杂的评测（如红队测试或提升研究）。
attestations.quote_en: Early in the final training run, developers can focus on highly scalable evaluations (such as automated benchmarks); as the model approaches known capability frontiers, more complex evaluations (such as red-teaming or uplift studies) should be conducted.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: Attested as the rendering of 'real-world uplift', but we recommend against it standing alone: in Chinese it is a straightforwardly positive term and is used throughout the same document for benign capability progress, so the threat framing is lost entirely.

attestations.quote_zh: 恶意使用风险562026年国际人工智能安全报告相关能力有所提高，但现实世界提升的证据不一在最近发表的一项现实世界能力提升的研究中，与仅接入互联网的基线相比，未配备相关安全防护措施的通用型人工智能系统可以为生物武器获取的替代任务提供大量协助(33*)。
attestations.quote_en: Relevant capabilities have improved but evidence of real-world uplift is mixed. In a recently published real-world uplift study, general-purpose AI systems without relevant safeguards provided substantial assistance on proxy tasks for bioweapon acquisition, compared with an internet-only baseline.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.notes: How Chinese safety text actually conveys the threat sense — as a descriptive phrase about assisting a novice, not as a named quantity. Also 实质协助, 大量协助.

definition_en: A published document accompanying a model release that states its intended use, training data, evaluation results, limitations and safety properties. A system card covers the deployed system rather than the bare model and is where frontier labs now publish their safety test results.

definition_en: Anthropic's public commitment document tying model capability levels to required safeguards: if evaluations show a model has crossed a defined capability threshold, specified security and deployment measures must be in place before training or release continues. The first published document of its kind and the template for the frontier safety framework genre.
definition_zh: Anthropic公开发布的承诺文件，把模型的能力等级与必须配套的防护措施绑定：一旦评测显示模型越过既定能力阈值，就必须先落实相应的安保与部署措施，才能继续训练或发布。它是同类文件中最早公开的一份，也确立了前沿安全框架这一体裁。
pitfalls: Genuinely unsettled on two axes at once: 政策 vs 策略 (policy vs strategy) and 扩展 vs 规模化 (scaling). Concordia AI writes 《负责任扩展政策》 while the Chinese edition of the International AI Safety Report writes 《负责任的扩展策略》 — in the same six-month window, for the same document. Separately, 扩展 for 'scaling' collides with the Chinese ML term for scaling laws (扩展定律/缩放定律) and could be read as 'expanding the product', not 'scaling up model capability'. The English 'responsible scaling' is itself contested in English; the Chinese inherits that. In practice Chinese writers usually just write RSP in Latin letters after a first gloss, which is the honest recommendation.

translations.notes: Concordia AI's choice; pairs with their 《负责任扩展政策》（RSP） formatting.

definition_en: The genre of document in which a frontier developer commits in advance to evaluating for specified dangerous capabilities, defines thresholds, and states what safeguards or halts follow when a threshold is crossed. Google DeepMind's document carries this exact name; OpenAI's is the Preparedness Framework, Anthropic's the RSP.
definition_zh: 前沿开发者预先承诺的一类文件：约定要评测哪些危险能力、设定相应阈值，并规定阈值被触发后必须采取的防护措施或暂停动作。谷歌DeepMind的同名文件叫《前沿安全框架》，OpenAI的叫《应急准备框架》，Anthropic的则是RSP。
pitfalls: Chinese has done something English has not: it has separated the proper noun from the genre. 前沿安全框架 is used specifically for Google DeepMind's document, while the umbrella category is 前沿AI风险管理框架 / 前沿人工智能风险管理框架 — the phrasing Concordia AI uses to cover all five labs, and the title of the Chinese-origin framework issued by Shanghai AI Lab with Concordia AI in July 2025. If you write 前沿安全框架 when you mean the genre, a well-read Chinese reader will think you mean DeepMind's. Note also that the Chinese umbrella term foregrounds 风险管理 (risk management), aligning the genre with ISO-style enterprise risk management rather than with 'safety' as a distinct value — a framing choice that makes the genre legible to PRC regulators. There is a native Chinese instance of this genre, which matters: 上海人工智能实验室 and 安远AI's framework uses a 红线/黄线 two-tier threshold system rather than importing ASL-style numbered levels.

translations.notes: Used as the proper name of Google DeepMind's document in both the International AI Safety Report Chinese edition and Concordia AI's writing.

definition_en: Anthropic's tiered scheme, modelled on biosafety levels, in which each level pairs a description of model capability with the security and deployment safeguards required at that level. ASL-3 was first triggered in 2025.
definition_zh: Anthropic参照生物安全等级（BSL）设计的分级体系，每一级都把模型能力的描述与该级别必须落实的安保与部署防护措施配对。ASL-3于2025年首次被触发。
pitfalls: The collision the hint flags is real and worth stating carefully. PRC cybersecurity has a legally mandated, deeply entrenched grading regime — 网络安全等级保护 ('MLPS', colloquially 等保), with five levels, its own national standards (e.g. GB/T 25070-2019) and a compliance step literally called 等级测评. The Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI frontier framework cites 等级保护 in its security section, so both vocabularies genuinely coexist in one Chinese AI-safety document. A bare 安全等级 in PRC context will therefore be read as an MLPS compliance grade — a static grading of the system's protection level assigned by regulation — not as a capability-triggered tier that a model can cross during training. Keep the AI/ASL prefix (AI安全等级(ASL)) rather than writing 安全等级 alone. Secondary point: 安全 here means safety, whereas in 等级保护 it means security; the collapse makes the two look even more alike than they are.

translations.notes: Concordia AI's form; normally written with (ASL) appended.

definition_en: A pre-defined level of model capability which, once evaluations show it has been reached, triggers a specified response — heightened safeguards, restricted deployment, or halting development. The mechanism that turns a frontier safety framework from a statement of values into a commitment.
definition_zh: 预先设定的模型能力水平；一旦评测显示模型达到该水平，就触发既定动作——提升防护等级、限制部署或停止研发。正是这一机制把前沿安全框架从表态变成承诺。
pitfalls: The translation is easy; the interesting part is that Chinese frontier-safety work has a native alternative framing. Rather than importing numbered capability levels, the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI framework builds a two-tier 红线 / 黄线 system: 红线 marks unacceptable outcomes, 黄线 an early-warning indicator that escalates safeguards. 红线 is one of the most resonant words in PRC political language (bottom lines that must not be crossed) and connects directly to the IDAIS-Beijing 红线 vocabulary, so it carries far more weight with a Chinese policy audience than 能力阈值 does. Note the framing difference is substantive, not just lexical: 红线 is defined on outcomes, 能力阈值 on model capabilities — the Chinese framework deliberately anchors on the former.

translations.notes: Standard across translated and native frontier-safety writing.

usage_examples.zh: 当模型已具备执行某一威胁场景中的核心关键步骤时，触发黄线预警，启动深度评估与缓解。
usage_examples.en: When the model can already carry out the core critical steps of a threat scenario, the yellow-line warning is triggered and deeper evaluation and mitigation begin.

definition_en: The difference between the capability an evaluation measured and the capability the model actually has, caused by the evaluator not trying hard enough — weak prompting, no scaffolding, no fine-tuning, limited compute. It means every dangerous-capability result is a lower bound, and a determined attacker may exceed it.
definition_zh: 评测所测得的能力与模型真实能力之间的落差，成因是评测方没有把能力充分逼出来——提示不够好、没有脚手架、未做微调、算力不足。这意味着任何危险能力评测结果都只是下界，有备而来的攻击者可能超出它。
pitfalls: No Chinese term exists, and there is an active trap. Chinese AI-safety documents do have a well-attested term 评测差距, but it renders 'evaluation gap' and points the OPPOSITE way: it means pre-deployment evaluations OVERSTATE real-world usefulness because benchmarks do not capture task complexity. Translating 'elicitation gap' as 评测差距 would therefore invert the argument — an elicitation gap says the measurement is too low, an 评测差距 says it is too high. Chinese sources do describe the elicitation-gap phenomenon, but only narratively (e.g. third parties using scaffolding to reveal stronger cyber capability than pre-deployment testing found). Record the gap; do not reach for 评测差距.

translations.notes: Our coinage, paired with the 能力引出 proposal under capability-elicitation. Chosen over 激发差距 because 引出 does not carry 激发's positive 'boost performance' valence. Not attested anywhere; offered explicitly as a proposal, not a report of usage.

DO NOT use for 'elicitation gap'. It is well attested but means 'evaluation gap' in the opposite direction — evaluations overstating real-world capability. Recorded here as a false friend, with its attestation, so the trap is visible.

attestations.quote_zh: 一个反复出现的主题是“评测差距”：系统在部署前评测（如基准测试）中的表现往往似乎高估了其实际效用，因为此类评测未能充分反映现实世界任务的全部复杂性。
attestations.quote_en: A recurring theme is the 'evaluation gap': systems' performance in pre-deployment evaluations (such as benchmarks) often appears to overstate their real-world usefulness, because such evaluations do not fully capture the complexity of real-world tasks.

translations.zh: 部署前测试低估模型真实能力
translations.pinyin: bùshǔ qián cèshì dīgū móxíng zhēnshí nénglì
translations.literal_back: pre-deployment testing underestimates the model's true capability
translations.notes: How Chinese safety text actually conveys the idea — as a clause, not a term. VERIFICATION 2026-08-08: quote re-checked verbatim against the report PDF and confirmed. This is a descriptive gloss, so by design no fixed term appears in the quoted sentence.

attestations.quote_zh: 例如，有第三方通过利用脚手架，揭示了某些模型的网络能力比部署前测试中测得的网络能力更强(467*、521)。
attestations.quote_en: For example, third parties using scaffolding have shown that some models' cyber capabilities are stronger than what pre-deployment testing measured.

usage_examples.zh: 由于存在能力引出差距，部署前测得的网络攻击能力只能视为下界。
usage_examples.en: Because of the elicitation gap, cyberattack capability measured before deployment should be treated only as a lower bound.

definition_en: The discrepancy between how well a system performs in controlled pre-deployment evaluation and how useful or risky it turns out to be in real-world deployment. In the 2026 International AI Safety Report it names a recurring finding that benchmarks overstate practical utility.
definition_zh: 系统在受控的部署前评测中的表现，与其在真实部署环境中的实际效用或风险之间的落差。《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》用它概括一个反复出现的发现：基准测试往往高估了模型的实际效用。
pitfalls: Added by research because it kept surfacing and is systematically confusable with 'elicitation gap' in the other direction. Note the asymmetry: 评测差距 as used in the Chinese report describes evaluations flattering the model on utility, while the safety literature's elicitation gap describes evaluations understating dangerous capability. Both can be true of the same model at once, which is exactly why one Chinese term should not be made to serve both.

translations.notes: Used repeatedly and consistently in the Chinese edition of the International AI Safety Report, including in its key-findings summary.

attestations.quote_zh: 存在“评测差距”：人工智能系统在部署前评测等受控环境中经常有出色的表现，但在现实世界环境下表现较差。
attestations.quote_en: There is an 'evaluation gap': AI systems often perform excellently in controlled settings such as pre-deployment evaluations, but worse in real-world environments.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）

attestations.quote_zh: “评测差距”意味着仅凭基准测试结果无法可靠预测实际应用中的效用或风险。
attestations.quote_en: The 'evaluation gap' means benchmark results alone cannot reliably predict real-world utility or risk.
